item.title: U.S. retail sales flat in December as consumers pull back
item.description: U.S. retail sales stalled in December as Americans cut spending on cars and big-ticket items, signaling slower consumer growth amid inflation and tariffs.

item.title: Growth in U.S. labor costs cools in fourth quarter
item.description: U.S. labor costs rose 0.7% in Q4 2023, marking the smallest annual increase in 4.5 years amid weakening labor demand, according to the Labor Department.

item.title: Trump threatens to block opening of Gordie Howe Bridge
item.description: President Trump threatened to block the Gordie Howe International Bridge unless Canada meets U.S. trade demands, alarming Michigan leaders and businesses.

item.title: Laid-off laborers concerned over Hudson Tunnel pause
item.description: Hundreds of workers were laid off after President Trump froze federal funds for the $16B Gateway tunnel, prompting lawsuits and a court fight.

item.title: Fed’s Miran says Trump tariffs hurt foreign firms, not Americans
item.description: Federal Reserve Governor Stephen Miran says Trump trade tariffs have had a muted economic impact and argues foreign firms, not U.S. consumers, pay the cost.

item.title: American optimism about future hits nearly 20-year low
item.description: Americans’ optimism about their future quality of life has fallen to a near two-decade low, Gallup finds, with sharp declines among minorities and Democrats.

item.title: Just Sold: Glencoe apartments draw $145,344 per unit
item.description: Glencoe may be well outside the Twin Cities, but an 86-unit apartment community there turned heads recently when it drew multiple competitive offers before selling at $12.5M.

item.title: Trump housing goals may clash with Warsh’s Fed balance sheet plans
item.description: Trump wants lower mortgage rates, but his Fed pick Kevin Warsh favors shrinking the Fed’s bond portfolio, a move that could push borrowing costs higher.

item.title: Welltower buys Fridley senior living facility for $39.5M
item.description: Welltower has acquired the 136-unit Willows Bend Senior Living in Fridley for $39.5 million in cash, marking its sixth Twin Cities purchase.

item.title: Treasure Island Buffalo Tower reopens after renovation
item.description: Treasure Island Resort & Casino reopens its renovated Buffalo Tower in Welch with redesigned rooms, new amenities and a 12-month overhaul by Knutson Construction.
